category_title: Preschoolers exhibiting physical aggression such as hitting, pushing, and kicking peers
minimal_context: The student is playing in the classroom and is expected to share toys with their peers.
dialogue:
TUTOR: It is time to play in the classroom. Please remember we are sharing toys with our friends.

STUDENT: (Holds onto a toy tightly) I don't want to share the toys.

TUTOR: You need to share with your classmates.

STUDENT: (Pushes a classmate who comes near) No! I am playing with the girls' houses!

TUTOR: Please do not push.

STUDENT: (Kicks the classmate and throws a toy) Go away! I'm going to mess the girls' houses up!

options.A: Explain the rules, talk about right and wrong behaviors, work on the rules and behaviors in the first two weeks, and ask the parents to take notes about the child's behavior at home.
options.B: Use classroom playtime as an opportunity for the student to learn and practice social and emotional learning skills, such as communication, sharing, turn-taking, and collaboration.
options.C: Place an exclusive display board in the classroom only for the student to showcase their creations with the girls' houses throughout the daily sessions.
options.D: Vary classroom activities by including more active learning strategies, including cooperative play groups with the toys, throughout the daily sessions.
